BALATRO-JACK_IN_THE_BOX_EVENT.title: Jack in the Box
BALATRO-JACK_IN_THE_BOX_EVENT.pages.INIT:
You come upon a strange box just large enough to fit you in.
It even has a door with a sign on it that says: "Unparalleled strength requires a sacrifice".
Lose [red]30[/red] Max HP and [red]300[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold] and gain a special reward.
BALATRO-JACK_IN_THE_BOX_EVENT.pages.ENTE:
The moment you close the door behind you, it feels like you are being drained while a wind up sounds starts playing.
Suddenly the feeling and the winding up stops and you hear a click. A quiet voice whispers "What is thy destiny?".
Create [blue]2[/blue] copies of any card in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
BALATRO-JACK_IN_THE_BOX_EVENT.pages.DUPL: Choose a card to duplicate twice.
BALATRO-JACK_IN_THE_BOX_EVENT.pages.FINI:
When the words leave your mouth, the floor suddenly shoots up and launches you out the top of the box.
While flying through the air a laughing voice continuously repeats "Jack in the box", but it stops as soon as you finally land.
BALATRO-JACK_IN_THE_BOX_EVENT.pages.HURT:
As you kick over the box an angry voice screams at you. A sudden spring shoots up from the box, hitting you.
When recovering from the hit, you notice that some gold sprang out too.
BALATRO-SPECTRAL_MERCHANT_EVENT.title: Spectral Merchant
BALATRO-SPECTRAL_MERCHANT_EVENT.pages.IN: You see a familiar figure, it seems to be the Merchant.
BALATRO-SPECTRAL_MERCHANT_EVENT.pages.AP:
As you get closer, it suddenly turns around and a spectral shape flies at and through you.
You are unharmed but it seems like you have lost something.
And when it seemed to have calmed down it apologizes and offers you some reimbursement.
Remove {RandomCardRare} from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Add [blue]1[/blue] Rare card to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
Remove {RandomCardUncommon} from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Add [blue]2[/blue] Uncommon cards to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
Remove {RandomCardCommon} from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Add [blue]3[/blue] Common cards to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
BALATRO-SPECTRAL_MERCHANT_EVENT.pages.FI: It apologizes again and says an awkward goodbye.
